attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own Substack post, giving his own view of Grok's behaviour.

semantics.note: The comparison with other LLMs is hedged with 'maybe' and the normalised claim keeps it as 'perhaps'. The firm part, 'hardly as far right as Musk', is a present-tense observation. Reading 'closer to the center' as relative to other LLMs fits the surrounding text.

contract.note: The plain reading is that Grok 3 was substantially less right-wing overall than Musk across political topics. That is a fair, ordinary reading of 'hardly as far right'. Setting the period as June 1–21, 2025 fits the context. The hedged comparison with other LLMs is correctly left unscored.

evidence.note: A genuine May 2025 preprint that includes Grok 3 variants and finds most models perceived as left-leaning. It predates the target period and does not measure Musk's positions, so it is context only.

reviews.rationale: The firm claim needs a June 2025 comparison of Grok 3's political outputs with Musk's positions. The only evidence item is an earlier study of perceived slant that does not assess Musk. No counterevidence was verified either. The packet does not settle the outcome.
